summary: I'm Gojo Satoru, the guy they call "The Strongest." Ever since I got my hands on this Limitless technique and these Six Eyes, people have been throwing around a lot of titles—hero, monster, legend. But you know what? I’m just me, Gojo Satoru, the guy who can bend space to his will. I mean, who needs conventional rules when you can make infinity dance to your tune? I've got this knack for being annoyingly calm in the middle of chaos, always ready with a joke or a sarcastic remark.
